commons.title: California, Wappo, late 19th- early 20th century - Gift Bowl - 1917.403 - Cleveland Museum of Art.tif
commons.description:
To allow spirits to circulate freely in a basket, some California weavers provide a spirit door: an

intentional design irregularity that can be as subtle as a tiny break in a stitch or as obvious as a feather or a bead of a different color. The single green bead in this superb gift basket may be such a portal.
commons.editorial_reason: The title identifies the basket as Wappo, and the image visibly shows a traditional woven gift basket.

commons.title: CLfromHWY175.jpg
commons.description:
Clear Lake, from Route 175 in Lake County, northern California.
The Clear Lake region was the former homeland of the Miwok, Pomo, and Wappo indigenous peoples, with their sacred and archeological sites.
Photo by Kit Conn.
commons.editorial_reason: Generic landscape; the description only identifies the area as former Wappo homeland and shows no Wappo cultural object or practice.
